sources.title: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission: Hotel Chelsea, March 15, 1966
sources.inspection: Read the official designation report: eleven-story Victorian Gothic facade, stacked ornamental iron balconies with plant motifs and French doors, central steep pyramidal roof between substantial brick chimneys, and two end wings with pointed-arch openings in brick gables. These features corroborate the local photographs.

Official current hotel page confirms rooftop spa and garden and the historic steeple fitness room. It does not provide measured roof geometry; hidden modern rooftop fit-out is conservatively simplified.
